svg.title: Project NorthStar upgrade landscape - temporary N+1 line (adapted from SAP Upgrade Guide figure, section 3.1)

text.tspan: NorthStar upgrade landscape: go-live line upgraded in place; DS5 / QS5 copies stay on FPS02 as the temporary line (SAP Upgrade Guide 3.1, second option)
Temporary system landscape (N+1): FPS02 fallback until G4 (19 Nov), then SPS06 on 1 / 3 Dec
Go-live landscape (N): upgraded in transport order with one target stack (an MP transaction per system, equal to MP 1002693650)
FPS02 fixes: DS5 > QS4 to 5 Nov, DS5 > SS4 to 12 Nov
SPDD / SPAU transports from DS4 reused in QS4, SS4, PS4 (and DS5, QS5 in Dec)
SLT for Central Finance (N): suspend and
resume around the QS4 and SS4 windows
SAP GTS development, connected to DS4
SAP GTS QA: SIT with QS4; client 300 =
UAT with SS4; no GTS pre-production
AFC, MBC, DRC Mexico, Work Zone
Copies XS4, DS5, QS5 stay disconnected from all of the above
Adapted for NorthStar from the SAP Upgrade Guide for S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 2023 (v6.0), section 3.1 (temporary development and QA system landscape). Dates: plan v4, US Central.
